3. Check the state of the Docker containers (db, keycloak, pgadmin, valhalla, streamlet, reverse-proxy)
4. Check whether run-dev is running (backend on port 3030, Vite on port 5173)
5. Test the endpoints via Traefik on port 3000
6. Verify that the build artifacts exist (bin/green-ecolution, frontend/app/dist)
7. Verify that migrations have been applied

Alright, let's get started.
